metadata.title: PS3 Longplay 081 Metal Gear Solid 4 (a)
metadata.creator: Spazbo4
metadata.description:
Normal difficulty

I was asked to do this longplay since the original doesn't have that good of quality.

Ever since I saw the first trailer for teh game back in 2005 I could not wait for it to come out, I thought it was going to be the best game ever and in some portions it didn't disappoint but there were a few parts in the game that I did not like, for example all the gameplay of chapter 3 I really did not like, following the guy and then the motorcycle chase I always thought was boring just like in MGS3

I am not the best at sneaking around at this game but I do try to have fun while playing.

Sometimes during the long cutscenes I might have been afk during it to piss or something, so sometimes I might not see the flashbacks that require to press x so sorry if that happens.

During chapter 4 I don't know where all of the ghosts are but I do try to find a few and I just take a lot of pictures in some areas to see if I can find any as the only one I really know of is of Hideo Kojima at the Policenauts poster in Hal's lab.
